text:
Maya: quick sync from the playground design review — need a decision on how the request schema inspector should surface for tool-calls. modal vs slide-out panel? want to ship something small & a11y-safe this sprint. :thought_balloon:
Ravi: saw the problem when a function has many params — the inspector becomes vertically cramped and the copy example button is pushed out of the visible area on narrower screens. :clipboard:
Lena: a11y: whichever pattern we pick, keyboard/assistive support is must-have: focus trap, role=dialog for modal, skiplinks for panel, aria-live for copy feedback. also confirm icon contrast at smaller sizes.
Theo: product POV: modal is lower-risk and less layout-shift, panel is better for side-by-side debugging. tradeoff: discoverability vs context.
Maya: proposal: default to compact modal with a "Pop out" control that detaches to a persistent right-side panel. avoids committing to one global layout and supports comparisons.
Ravi: dev constraints — run history replay exhibits a lazy-render bug: when viewing older runs with tool-calls, the inspector often shows empty state until you click the tool header. likely SSR/hydration mismatch with our lazy import. repro steps below:
```
- playground -> Run History
- open entry that includes tool invocation
- expand tool block
- inspector displays "No schema" until header toggle
```
Ravi: i'll add a small failing test and try forcing eager render for the initial open.
Lena: copy interaction: current tooltip "Copied" disappears too quickly for screen readers. Recommend updating to an aria-live region that announces "Example copied" and remains programmatically available until next copy. also support keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl + C) on the example code block.
Maya: microcopy tweak: instead of "View schema" let's use "Open request schema (read-only)" to set expectation and avoid confusion with editable payloads.
Ravi: implementation notes: we can reuse utils/prettyJson and the existing CodeBlock component. for huge schemas (>150 lines) we'll paginate and lazy-render pages to keep initial paint under 200ms.
Theo: also add a small hint under the button: "Tip: press ⌘/Ctrl+C to copy example" so it's discoverable.
Lena: UI details: ensure the copy button has 4.5:1 contrast at 12px; if not, increase size or change color to #5B6670. knight: add focus-visible ring and visible focus state for keyboard users.
Maya: keyboard flow for modal: autofocus search input, Esc closes, Tab order: search -> pagination -> copy -> close. For the side panel detach, preserve same shortcuts and provide a close affordance.
Ravi: dev backlog items (owners):
- fix run-history hydration so inspector renders on initial open (owner: Ravi)
- build modal with detach -> side panel (owner: Maya + Ravi)
- implement aria-live copy feedback & keyboard shortcut (owner: Lena)
- microcopy + hint changes (owner: Theo)
Maya: estimate please in the ticket and we'll prioritize.
Theo: quick poll — react :one: for modal default, :two: for panel default.
Ravi: :one:
Lena: :one:
Maya: :one: (modal default + detacher)
UI-Bot: created ticket RD-UX-3199 "Playground request schema inspector — modal default + detach, copy accessibility + hydration fix" and linked this thread.
